items.quote: log per-step continuous proxies inside rollouts that already run
items.reason: Changes measured quantity to per-step proxies, but still needs closed-loop rollouts; no open-loop scoring on recorded observations.

items.quote: branch steered vs unsteered copies from each checkpoint for short horizons
items.reason: Shortens closed-loop horizons via checkpoint branching; effects still come from simulated closed-loop segments, not fixed recorded observations.

items.quote: spend rollouts only on verifying top correlational candidates
items.reason: Screens logs then confirms top candidates, but scores correlational activation gaps, not steering effects on recorded observations.

items.quote: closed-loop rollouts are then spent only on the top-k features by divergence
items.reason: Scores steering by open-loop action divergence on recorded states; closed-loop rollouts only confirm top-k features.

items.quote: Change the objective from per-feature rate estimation to best-arm identification
items.reason: Adaptive allocation and progress scores change what rollouts buy, but evaluation stays closed-loop.

items.quote: Change the measured quantity from success rate in sim to the transfer coefficient itself
items.reason: Measures sim-to-real transfer of steering effects using closed-loop episodes in both domains; no open-loop screen.

items.quote: estimate the infinite-member skill S_inf and the convergence exponent
items.reason: Replaces the skill-at-N ladder with asymptote extrapolation and date-bootstrap resolvability.

items.quote: then draw arbitrarily many virtual members on CPU
items.reason: Replaces GPU member rollouts with fitted-distribution sampling, removing member count as a compute axis.

items.quote: vary the number of distinct model distributions they are drawn from
items.reason: Swaps member count for model-family diversity at fixed size, so compute buys decorrelated error rather than redraws.

items.quote: Change the axis from member count to member diversity
items.reason: Separates Monte Carlo convergence from shared-model error by resampling, then spends compute on new seeds, not more draws.

items.quote: the error of the ensemble-implied return level at fixed physical thresholds
items.reason: Changes the measured quantity to return-level error, whose rarity scales with members, unlike fixed top-percentile scores.

items.quote: run members in sequential batches with a stopping rule once the slope's sign is resolved
items.reason: Adds a power test and sequential stopping, shifting compute toward dates; changes ordering and what is measured.

items.quote: from the absolute property of one molecule to the sign of the difference within a pair
items.reason: Scores pairwise ordering where shared bias cancels; simulation targets ambiguous pairs instead of absolute error.

items.quote: make the force field itself the object of compute
items.reason: Fits force-field parameters before adding molecules, so compute can lower the floor rather than re-measure it.

items.quote: Change the unit of work from molecule to mixture
items.reason: Simulates blends directly, the object actually ranked, testing mixing predictability rather than more pure-liquid runs.

items.quote: Redirect compute from more molecules to a chemistry-conditioned correction
items.reason: Learns a descriptor-based residual correction so added molecules improve a transferable model, not re-measure the floor.

items.quote: Change the measured quantity to a cheaper related one that converges in about 1 ns
items.reason: Swaps Green-Kubo viscosity for a fast diffusion proxy, so compute buys chemical coverage instead of trajectory length.

items.quote: decompose per-replica percent errors into between-molecule and within-molecule variance
items.reason: Reorders work so a variance decomposition decides whether compute goes to coverage or run length.

items.quote: on a fixed buffer of recorded observations, then pay closed-loop rollouts only for the top-k features by effect size
items.reason: Open-loop steering divergence on recorded observations screens features; closed-loop rollouts only for top-k.

items.quote: replace binary success with a continuous physical readout
items.reason: Changes the readout to force traces on real closed-loop grasps; no open-loop scoring on recorded observations.

items.quote: calibrate the sim-to-real transfer function of steering effect sizes
items.reason: Measures sim-to-real transfer of steering deltas with closed-loop sim and real trials; no open-loop screen.

items.quote: Change the unit of work to a short paired contact-window intervention
items.reason: Short steered windows still execute closed-loop in sim and real; not scored on fixed recorded observations.

items.quote: Change the objective to a paired rare-tail and recovery claim
items.reason: Retargets measurement to failure tails and recovery using perturbed closed-loop episodes; closed-loop dependency remains.

items.quote: Measure steering as a function of SE(3) displacement
items.reason: Measures pose retention of steering through closed-loop trials; no open-loop scoring on recorded observations.

items.quote: estimate the asymptote and curvature of skill vs 1/M instead of skill at large M
items.reason: Fits a + b/M on archived subsamples to measure the cap directly instead of running large-M forecasts.

items.quote: pick the allocation that minimizes the standard error of the quantity of interest
items.reason: Optimizes the dates-by-members allocation for the gain's standard error; compute buys independent cases, not redraws.

items.quote: measure the cap directly as tail calibration of the exchangeable distribution plus tail-error dependence
items.reason: Measures tail calibration and effective ensemble size, testing the cap directly rather than watching skill flatten.

items.quote: reallocate a fixed number of member-forecasts across (dates x members) to minimize the standard error
items.reason: Treats the budget as experimental design from variance components; compute buys verification dates, not redundant members.

items.quote: fit the score's a + b/N law from nested subsamples of a few hundred members and extrapolate
items.reason: Extrapolates the asymptote from a fitted law instead of buying the curve point by point.

items.quote: a group-sequential test that adds members in batches of 50 and stops
items.reason: Reorders work into an adaptive sequential test on the yes/no decision; compute spent only until resolved.

items.quote: derive per-molecule atomic charges from a cheap DFT single point (RESP-style)
items.reason: Varies force-field charges per molecule so compute can lower the error floor rather than document it.

items.quote: Invert the order of steps: fit a small chemistry-conditioned correction
items.reason: Fits a correction on published data first and tests generalization cheaply, so added molecules buy correction generality.

items.quote: rank candidates by their simulated temperature response
items.reason: Measures temperature slopes where multiplicative force-field error cancels; extra temperatures buy new ranking signal.

items.quote: spend the compute on a force-field/parameterization axis instead
items.reason: Varies force-field parameterizations on a fixed panel, so each run tests a different error floor.

items.quote: compute self-diffusion coefficient D from mean-squared displacement
items.reason: Replaces slow Green-Kubo with a fast diffusion proxy calibrated on a subset, so compute buys screening coverage.

items.quote: the learning curve of a class-conditional bias model
items.reason: Makes a pooled class-conditional correction and its learning curve the object, so molecules shrink a shared bias model.

items.quote: measure the transfer coefficient of the steering effect itself
items.reason: Measures sim-real rank agreement of closed-loop steering deltas; no open-loop recorded-observation screen.

items.quote: rank features by that probe, and buy closed-loop rollouts only for the top-k
items.reason: Open-loop probe on a fixed bank of recorded states ranks features; closed-loop rollouts bought only for top-k.

items.quote: fit SAEs on activations from contact-rich and deformable episodes
items.reason: Changes the SAE training distribution; evaluation still uses closed-loop ablation episodes, no open-loop screen.

items.quote: serial closed-loop rollouts are reserved for the few features the screen promotes
items.reason: Scores open-loop action divergence on recorded frames; closed-loop rollouts reserved for features the screen promotes.

items.quote: Change the objective from estimation to screening
items.reason: Sequential testing cuts closed-loop episodes but keeps closed-loop outcomes as the measured quantity.

items.quote: Test transfer of the delta, not the behavior
items.reason: Tests sim-to-real correlation of closed-loop steering deltas; does not score on recorded observations.

items.quote: build it from 4 partially independent sources
items.reason: Holds member count fixed and varies error sources, so compute buys diversity instead of redraws.

items.quote: measure the distribution across events of the 50->250 member gain instead of one pooled number
items.reason: Measures per-event gain distribution across many dates; borderline, since it largely runs the same forecasts on more dates.

items.quote: fit score(N) = a + b/N from a small pilot
items.reason: Estimates asymptote and tail dispersion from a pilot before committing; gates spend toward recalibration if capped.

items.quote: Reorder the steps: measure exchangeability first
items.reason: Measures member error correlation and effective ensemble size first, deriving the gain bound instead of running 1,000 members.

items.quote: fit a generalized Pareto tail (peaks over threshold) to each grid point's 50-member ensemble
items.reason: Replaces empirical member counting with a tail model, so compute buys dates rather than members.

items.quote: Hold GPU-hours fixed and make diversity the axis
items.reason: Pools checkpoints at equal cost so compute buys independent error modes, directly testing the shared-error cap.

items.quote: compute viscosity by reverse non-equilibrium MD
items.reason: Changes the estimator to separate truncation from force-field bias, rather than adding identical Green-Kubo replicas.

items.quote: score pairwise ordering accuracy and Spearman rank of computed versus measured properties first
items.reason: Changes the objective to ranking accuracy, so each added molecule adds pair tests rather than absolute precision.

items.quote: replace 6 long replicas with many short decorrelated-started replicas run side by side
items.reason: Main payoff is resizing replicas to run more short copies side by side; estimand unchanged, compute buys more of the same.

items.quote: Change the measured quantity from absolute properties to paired differences
items.reason: Scores sign agreement of paired differences where shared bias cancels; compute buys ordering decisions.

items.quote: screen with self-diffusion from the Einstein relation
